conversion_adaptations: Final independently re-evaluates the three public workloads together with the three source hidden workloads to satisfy T35; no workload shape or seed was invented.
Continuous scoring uses the accepted fixed absolute candidate-time curve with a frozen 0.020-second scale derived from exact-environment Rust 1.94.1 six-workload calibration.
Formal Agent answering is 18000 seconds with a separate 1800-second independent final; CPU train allowance is 100 and the model request limit is 64 MiB.
